fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Lower PCS Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released Answer Key form for the recruitment of Lower Subordinate Services PCS for various posts such as Mandi Supervisor, Amin / Auctioneer, Assistant Manager (Non-Technical), Clerk cum Typist / Cashier cum Clerk / Accounts Clerk, Assistant Treasury Accountant, Auditor, Centre In Charge, Executive Officer, Assistant Chakbandi Officer, Assistant Manager (Non-Technical) (Special Selection), and District Assistant Immunization Officer on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 2587 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Lower PCS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 29 May 2026, to 25 June 2026. The Examination was conducted on 23 August 2026. Candidates are advised to download their UPSSSC Lower PCS Answer Key 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 May 2026
  • Last Date : 25 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 June 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 02 July 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 16 July 2026
  • Mains Fee Payment Start : 20 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 23 August 2026
  • Exam City Details : 14 August 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 19 August 2026
  • Answer Key : 24 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.

UPSSSC Lower PCS Answer Key 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.
